tools.name: search_zoning_cases
tools.description: Search live municipal zoning cases, rezoning applications, site plans, moratorium alerts, and distressed rescue leads across Austin, Phoenix, Dallas, Seattle, Denver, Nashville, Columbus, and Boston.

tools.name: get_case_dossier
tools.description: Retrieve full details for a specific zoning case by case ID or municipal case number, including parcel APN, zoning request, hearing transcript excerpt, vote summary, and public dossier URL.

tools.name: list_moratoriums
tools.description: List active municipal moratoriums and battery energy storage (BESS), data center, or setback regulatory alerts across monitored metros.

tools.name: get_commissioner_scorecard
tools.description: Retrieve planning & zoning commissioner voting records, approval rates, average delay days, moratorium votes, top recurring objections, and notable quotes.
